title: Leaf from a Gradual: Initial P with the Nativity
medium: ink, tempera and gold on vellum
description: This beautiful initial P introduces the text Puer natus e[st] nobis, et filius datus est nobis (“For a child is born to us, and a son is given to us”) which marks the opening of the Introit for Christmas Day. The text, taken from Isaiah 9:6, continues, “. . . and his name shall be called Wonderful.” It is used to celebrate one of the most joyous events of the Christian Church—the birth of Christ. This splendid leaf from a manuscript gradual contains the chants used for solemn high Mass on Christ

title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Ape Fishing (verso)
medium: ink, tempera and liquid gold on vellum
description: This leaf shows the second half of Psalm 142. The page’s first line reads, “Non avertas faciem tuam a me,” or “Turn not away thy face from me.” This last page of the penitential psalms immediately precedes the litany of saints, which begins on the other side of this leaf. Below the text stands an ape fishing at a small pond across from a large bird, a scene possibly from a fable or simply meant to be amusing or diversionary.

medium: ink, tempera, and liquid gold on vellum
description: The calendar is usually located at the beginning of a book of hours. Much like calendars today, those in books of hours mark important days to be acknowledged throughout the year. These calendars are perpetual calendars, meaning adjustable, as to be accurate every year. Months are often illuminated with an image of the type of labor or zodiac sign associated with them, such as grapes in September, the month in which they were harvested. title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Calendar Page for June (verso)
medium: ink, tempera and liquid gold on vellum
description: On this calendar page, June is illustrated with the month’s labor of gathering hay. One figure cuts hay with a scythe while the other uses a rake to gather it. Also featured is a crab, signifying the month’s zodiac sign, Cancer. In this lavishly decorated leaf, the most important feast days are listed in gold, while other days are in alternating red and blue inks. culture: France, Burgundy, Archdiocese of Sens, Abbey of Pontigny, 12th century
description: This leaf was excised from a copy of the handbook of church law known as the Decretum written by Gratian, an Italian Camaldolese monk active in Bologna from about 1130 to 1140. The focus of the leaf is a large decorated letter Q with spiraling lotus petals introducing the first Causa, or case of law. title: Christ in Majesty with the Virgin and Saint John the Evangelist: Single Leaf from a Book of Rules
medium: ink, tempera, and gold on parchment
description: In this complex image, the Virgin and St. John stand next to Christ at the Last Judgment as the final trumpets blow. Assembled below are members of the Confraternity of St. John the Evangelist in Venice, robed in white with the insignia of their order: a pastoral staff and crosses. This beautiful page comes from a mariegola, or the book of rules of this confraternity. title: Initial S[alve sancta parens]  from a Gradual: Madonna and Child
medium: ink, tempera, and gold on vellum
description: Along with several other excised leaves and miniatures that survive in various libraries and museums, this decorated initial S was part of a magnificent gradual produced in the scriptorium of the monastery of Santa Maria degli Angeli in Florence. The Madonna and Child was a standard image for the Saturday votive Mass to the Virgin. This initial originally introduced the text: Salve sancta parens (“Hail, Holy Mother”).

medium: Ink, tempera and liquid gold on vellum
description: This leaf from a psalter and prayerbook is intricately decorated and was probably produced for use in a private noble family. The prominent mention of Saint Godehard (died 1038), Bishop of Hildesheim, in the original manuscript suggests that it was produced for use in the diocese of Hildesheim (Norther Germany).

title: Plaque
culture: Peru, North Coast, Chongoyape(?), Chavín style (900-200 BCE)
description: These plaques showing a powerful Chavín deity may come from a group of gold objects found in a lavish tomb in the 1920s. One is shaped as the deity’s fanged head, its fur transformed into sixteen serpents that edge the plaque. On the other, the deity’s visually elusive body also appears: the clawed hands over the chest may clutch a horizontal staff, an emblem of authority; across the waist is a belt that sprouts serpents; and beneath are the legs and feet, which stand atop fanged masks.

Belt buckles with large rectangular attachment plates have been discovered in cemeteries across the Iberian Peninsula-now occupied by Spain and Portugal-from the period of Visigothic occupation (about AD 412-711). title: Ornament with Figure
description: Affixed to a section of white shell is the image of a Wari dignitary, assembled of carefully carved mosaic elements. The purple and pink shapes are made of shell, while the green is serpentine. The spots on the figure's tunic are probably pyrite, which was originally smooth and reflective.

title: Pair of Fibulae
description: A woman of high rank might have worn these twin fibulae on her shoulders, one fastening her inner garment on the right, the other her outer garment on the left. She might also have suspended them from her belt as decorative ornaments.

title: Crescent-Shaped Earring
description: The Byzantine lady who wore this earring may also have woven similar ornaments into her hair. Those who could afford it adorned not only their body but also their clothing with glittering jewels and shimmering gold.

title: Buckle with Animal-Shaped Thorn and Belt Plate
medium: bronze with traces of gilding and garnets
description: Between the AD 200s and the 600s, the European West is characterized by the so-called "barbarian invasions," a term referring to the movement of various Germanic people into the Roman Empire. The period of the great migrations of these Germanic peoples was one of uncertainty and disorder. By the AD 300s, the collapse of Roman military power in the western provinces was increased by the westward movement of the Huns, an especially fierce enemy from the east. The Huns drove before them displaced G

title: Earrings
description: Each of these earrings is formed from a simple hoop that ends in a hook-and-loop closure. An oval garnet is fixed below the loop on each earring; one earring has a much larger garnet, and a small ball affixed above the setting. The lower portion of each earring is decorated with two parallel rows of granules.

title: Pendant of a Bird (Rooster?)
culture: Northern Greece, Macedonian, Geometric period  (900-700 BCE)
description: Although quite schematic, the subject of this pendant is easily recognizable as a bird, likely a rooster. Cleverly designed to hang evenly from its central suspension loop, it comprises three main parts: long neck terminating in a head with a pointy beak and small crest; triangular body with stylized feet; and broadly arched tail feathers.

title: Bronze Necklace with Hanging Pendants
description: 45 separately cast pendants overlap one another when strung together and hung, reversing course at the bottom.

title: Ring with Hippocampus
description: This delicate gold ring is decorated with a tiny hippocampus, a creature from Greco-Roman mythology with the forequarters of a horse and the tail of a fish. Stylized waves bracket the hippocampus, crashing up against its tail and front hooves. The thin band of the ring is decorated with horizontal lines to the halfway point on both sides.

title: Forehead Ornament
description: Nasca figures, like one on a bowl nearby, are shown wearing such forehead ornaments and mouth masks similar to these. The mouth mask hung from the nasal septum, the oval opening surrounding the mouth and the bristles positioned as feline whiskers, here transformed to serpents. Both were cut from sheet gold; details were worked freehand while the sheet rested on a soft surface.

title: Collar with Medallion and Pendant
date:
Collar: c. 200–300 CE,
Coin: c. 177 CE
description: This necklace is an amalgamation of several different pieces. A thick gold chain is attached to a central medallion, which holds a coin of the Roman emperor Commodus in its center, possibly an ancient replica. A second pendant chain is attached to the bottom of the medallion, strung with ten tiny amulets representing figures of gods, goddesses, and theatrical actors.

title: Comb
description: This luxury object is masterfully fashioned from a single piece of wood. The openwork carving is intended to resemble Gothic windows. The inscription reads, "mon ♥️ aves" on one side and "pour bien" on the other, translated to "you have my heart in your possession."

culture: Peru, South Coast, Chincha-Ica Valley area, 15th-16th century
description: The red pigment on the face is cinnabar, a mineral consisting of mercury sulfide.

title: Crossbow Fibula
culture: Gallo-Roman or Romano-British, Migration period, 4th century
description: A fibula was a garment clasp that functioned somewhat like a modern safety pin. Since buttons were not used in antiquity, fibulae were used to keep a cloak closed. They were worn by both men and women, commonly on the right shoulder, and produced in various sizes and shapes. Because they were highly visible accessories, they often received decorative gilding, inlay decoration, or onion-shaped domes. Crossbow fibulae were introduced by the Romans and are named for their resemblance to the weapon.

title: Pendant
culture: Northwestern India, Rajasthan, Rajput Kingdom of Jaipur
medium: Gold, emerald, diamonds, enamel, and pearl
description: The large green emerald on one side of this pendant was probably imported to India from Columbia. Delicately incised with a lotus blossom, a symbol of the sun, it is surrounded by inset diamonds in organic, petal-like shapes. Emeralds, especially prized for their green color, were associated with the planet Mercury in Hindu astrology and with the power to ward off evil in Islam. On the reverse, a peacock and two peahens surrounded by flowers are rendered using blue, green, and red glass.

title: Necklace
medium: gold, moonstone, garnet, emerald, cornelian, baroque pearl, and banded agate
description: Alternating semiprecious stones and granulated gold beads come together to form this magnificent necklace, capped with a gold clasp framed by banded agate cabochons. The pendant portion of this necklace is centered around a large translucent moonstone in a gold setting, framed by smaller garnet ovals, also set in gold. title: Pendant with Shri
description: A conflation of local and Hellenistic divinities, this goddess exemplifies abundance and prosperity. Like Tyche, she holds a cornucopia, overflowing with fruits and bounty, but it is in the form of a lotus flower, associated with the local Indian goddess of good fortune, Shri. To further emphasize this association, she holds a lotus flower in her right hand as well.

title: Pendants
medium: Gilt silver with diamonds, emeralds, rubies, pearls, and enamel
description: Worn either as earrings or pendants from a crown, these double-sided, symmetrical jeweled assemblages each feature a fish as the central ornament. The pair of fish is one of a set of eight auspicious symbols known in Indian art for more than two millennia. As creatures of the waters that are essential for life, they betoken fertility and abundance—attributes of an ideal ruler.

title: Necklace
description: Throughout the 1700s, the growing trade for personal luxury objects transformed the material culture surrounding marriage and courtship. Gifts such as perfume, sheet music, books, textiles, portrait miniatures, and jewelry often demonstrated the status of the gift giver and their investment in the relationship. title: Pendant with Chain
culture: Northwestern India, Rajasthan, Rajput Kingdom of Jaipur
medium: Gold, emerald, diamonds, enamel, and pearl
description: The central emerald has been subtly incised with a many-petaled lotus flower, a symbol of the sun, suggesting the radiance of the outsize gem. The enameling on the back depicts a peacock with a pair of peahens amid flowers. Peacocks signal the monsoon rains. The refined use of enamel indicates that this piece was assembled in the specialized workshops of Jaipur, but the size of the emerald suggests that it was made for imperial use.

title: Ornament from Sitio Conte: Animal Pendant(?)
description: Harvard archaeologists excavated the eight ornaments in this case from several burials at Sitio Conte, a cemetery famous for its lavish graves of powerful chieftains. The young man buried in Grave 26 was such a chief. His status was stunningly memorialized by 21 human companions and 475 objects, many of them personal ornaments made of gold, including the large chest plaque (no. 2) and the rod-shaped ear ornament (no. 3) shown here. culture: Byzantium, Late Roman, Eastern Mediterranean, (probably Sirium or Nicomedia), Byzantine period

description: Three emeralds and many pearls surround the central part of this pendant, which features a scene from the life of Matsya at the center. The fish incarnation of the preserver god Vishnu, Matsya appears in the middle, defeating the demon Hayagriva, who emerges from a shell, grasping him by the hair. title: Hair-Pipe Necklace
culture: Native North America, Plains, Nakota (Yankton or Yanktonai Sioux)?
medium: Cow-bone hair pipes, glass beads, brass beads, silk ribbon, metal coin, Native-tanned hide or rawhide stringing, vegetable-tanned hide separators
description: Among the most recognizable of Plains accouterments of the later 1800s are women’s necklaces and men’s breastplates made of so-called hair pipes, tubular beads originally made of shell. These prestigious chest ornaments became popular with the introduction of sturdier cow-bone pipes, nearly all manufactured by a mill in New Jersey and traded widely on the Plains. title: Necklace Bead and Pair of Pendants in the Shape of an Auspicious Symbol
culture: India, Uttar Pradesh or Madhya Pradesh, Shunga period (185–78 BCE)
description: These exceptionally fine pieces of gold jewelry would have been strung on a necklace. The auspicious symbols on either side of the egg-shaped bead are in the form of full blown lotus flowers with the seed pods carefully detailed, and trident-shaped forms decorated with stylized palmette motifs emanate down from the lotuses.

title: Button
medium: rock crystal with a garnet mounted in a gold granulated star
description: The decorative technique known as granulation had been used in Etruscan, Greek, and Roman jewelry well before this Byzantine piece was made. Granulation is when tiny spheres or “granules” are attached to a piece. It can be seen here in in a rock crystal button decorated with a six-pointed star, with a simply set garnet in the center.

description: Costa Rican jade pendants may imitate the shape of axe blades (celts) used for agriculture. The pendants often take the form of "axe gods," creatures with human, bird, or animal traits. title: Shell with Inlaid Feline
medium: Spondylus shell with shell, stone, and gold inlay
description: This ornament is made of a spondylus shell, from which the exterior surface has been carved away to reveal a layer of bright orange. The pampas cat inlaid on the surface in multicolored shell and stone has bean-shaped spots on his body, and grasps a gold gourd or fruit. In both Paracas and Nasca art, the small, non-domesticated pampas cat is strongly associated with beans and other crops. Perhaps it was thought to guard the fields from rodents and other pests.

title: String for Men's Hat
description: Made of either agarwood or red sandalwood, this bead string was once attached to a man's hat called a gat. Each bead bears an inscribed image of fish, birds, frogs, flowers, a boy holding a peach, and some characters of auspicious meanings such as longevity and good fortune.

title: Peacock Ring
department: Egyptian and Ancient Near Eastern Art
description: Made of gold inset with chalcedony, a type of quartz, this simple yet elegant signet ring has timeless appeal. A skilled artisan carved a peacock into the oval stone creating an emblem that would have had personal meaning for the owner.

description: Frans Hals porträttmåleri kännetecknas av en omedelbarhet i både den lätta med säkra penselföringen och i den levande framställningen av modellerna. Porträtten är inte högstämda som Rembrandts, utan Hals tycks ha koncentrerat sig på att förmedla direkta känslor och rena sinnesstämningar. Modellernas ofta avspända uttryck får betraktaren att uppleva det som om man kommer dem inpå livet, även om man inte vet vem personen är – som den borgerliga kvinnan i den här målningen.

title: Daniel van Aken

Med ledning av en teckning av Mathys van den Bergh (1617-1687) från 1655 (Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen, Rotterdam) har den avporträtterade identifierats som Daniel van Aken. title: Dansös betraktande sin högra fotsula
description: Degas ställde aldrig ut dessa skulpturer under sin livstid. De var skisser, ett arbetsmaterial, ursprungligen gjorda i mindre beständiga material som vax, plastelina och lera. Degas har inte daterat eller signerat skulpturerna. Efter hans död 1917, återfanns över 150 skulpturer i hans ateljé, i stort sett samtliga hade börjat förfalla. Degas arvtagare beslöt därför att tillåta att 72 av skulpturerna gjöts i brons i flera upplagor.

title: Fire: Small Blacksmith Crouching
description: Renoir created Fire: Small Blacksmith Crouching in the same year as Small Washerwoman Crouching, and Mother and Child. All three are representative of his late years and date from a period when the artist, who had been sickly since 1888, was suffering from an ever-deteriorating state of health. At the turn of the century Renoir had become badly afflicted and deformed by gout, and by 1904 had grown so emaciated that he could barely sit. description: The 1880s were troubled years for Renoir, replete with changes both in his work and personal life. title: La Grenouillère
description: La Grenouillère – Groddammen – var ett populärt bad- och rekreationsställe för Paris arbetare och medelklass i Bougival, strax väster om huvudstaden. I september 1869 tillbringade konstnärerna Auguste Renoir och Claude Monet några dagar där. De målade samma motiv, flera gånger ur olika perspektiv. Ambitionen var att fånga ögats intryck – l’impression - av motivet på duken. De arbetade med korta snabba penseldrag i rena, oblandade färger. title: Ung parisiska
description: Många av Renoirs kvinnoporträtt bör ses som skildringar av typer snarare än som porträtt av bestämda individer. Renoirs parisiska har också kallats La grisette – ett ord som betecknade kvinnor från arbetarklassen. Dessa unga kvinnor arbetade ofta som sömmerskor, tvätterskor eller butiksbiträden i städerna. De kvinnor som arbetade som konstnärsmodeller kom i regel också från arbetarklassen. Ordet grisette hade klang av lättsinne och fåfänga.

title: Rörelsestudie av dansös: stor arabesk, tredje positionen
description: Degas ställde aldrig ut dessa skulpturer under sin livstid. De var skisser, ett arbetsmaterial, ursprungligen gjorda i mindre beständiga material som vax, plastelina och lera. Degas har inte daterat eller signerat skulpturerna. Efter hans död 1917, återfanns över 150 skulpturer i hans ateljé, i stort sett samtliga hade börjat förfalla. Degas arvtagare beslöt därför att tillåta att 72 av skulpturerna gjöts i brons i flera upplagor.

title: Två dansöser
description: Pastellen föreställer två dansöser som förbereder sig inför en föreställning. Av rörelserna att döma justerar de sina örhängen och frisyrer. Degas har begränsat sin palett till endast två färger: rosa och blå-grön. Som ofta valde han att fokusera på dansösernas rörelser och poser – deras kroppar snarare än dem som individer. Pastellen ingår i en serie bilder till vilka Degas använde fotografier tagna i ateljén på Montmartre som förlagor.

title: Porträtt av konstkritikern Durand-Gréville
description: Konstkritikern Émile Durand-Gréville (1838-1914) tillhörde inte de mest framstående skribenterna i 1800-talets Paris. Han lärde känna Degas på 1870-talet. Mycket lite är känt om deras relation. Degas skildrar Durand-Gréville en face – framifrån. Mycket tyder på att porträttet är en skiss då bakgrunden verkar långt ifrån slutförd och det är osignerat. title: Svartklädd dam
description: Målningen visar en kvinna i svart klänning som sitter i en fåtölj eller en soffa. Hon visas från sidan, nästan i profil. Bakgrunden är mörkbrun med ett ljusare parti till vänster, vilken antyder ett fönster. Målningen är karaktäristisk för Degas kvinnoporträtt från den här tiden, vilka ofta gavs neutrala titlar utan modellens namn. title: Naketstudie till "14-årig dansös"

Hon levde under fattiga förhållanden tillsammans med sin mamma och två systrar, i närheten av Degas hem och ateljé på Montmartre. Rysk folkkonst och kultur var på modet i Paris vid sekelskiftet. Tsar Nikolaj II:s statsbesök år 1896 hade rönt mycket stor uppmärksamhet och bidrog sannolikt till intresset för det ryska. title: Portrait of a young Venetian man
description: The case shows that artworks not only included Greek quotations from classical literature and the Bible, but could also convey more basic information about their creation. Here the painter added the date and his name to the lower part of the portrait (transl. “1522, August the 28th, Victor’s handwork”). The use of Greek in the inscription enhances the painter's image as a pictor doctus (learned painter).

title: 1 Paar Leuchterfiguren
description: Die zwei Messingfigürchen, gekleidet nach dem Geschmack des ausgehenden 16. Jahrhunderts, waren vermutlich Teil zweier Tischleuchter. Der tellerförmige Stand und die Tropfschale mit Tülle gingen verloren. Erhalten blieb lediglich der Schaft in Form eines Mannes in Wams und Pluderhosen. Der erhobene rechte Arm trug Tropfschale und Tülle. Die beiden skurrilen Armleuchter sollen, laut Aussage der Vorbesitzerin, aus dem Schloss in Zeitz stammen. title: Portrait of Desiderius Erasmus
description: The portrait contains inscriptions in both Latin and Greek, the scholarly languages promoted by Erasmus. The Greek phrase emphasises the idea that Erasmus's writings provide a more accurate portrayal of his character than the visual arts (transl. "A better [image] his writings will show"), and thus offers a clever commentary on the portrait itself.

title: Portrait of a lady (Veronica Gambara?)
description: This is a rare example of a portrait of a woman featuring Greek. The bowl held by the sitter shows a partial quotation from Homer (Od. 4. 220-21). It refers to the medicine that 'banishes pain and sorrow' and 'calms anger' 'of all'. The inscription is consistent with the woman's plausible widowhood and cultural interests.

title: Portrait of Ugolino Martelli
description: The painting illustrates how ancient Greek texts could contribute to the creation of a cultured identity among the young aristocrats of the Italian city-states. The book in front of the sitter is a copy of Homer's Iliad, opened to the beginning of Book 9. The painting also contains a copy of Virgil and shows Ugolino's left arm resting on a work by Pietro Bembo, suggesting that the young nobleman had received (or was receiving) a thorough classical and literary education.

Die Grafik zeigt eine traditionsreiche hallesche Gaststätte, die "Goldene Rose", in einem traurigen Zustand.

title: Medal with self-portrait
description: This object features the name of the artist in both Hebrew and Greek, translating to "[Work of] Giovanni Boldù, painter". It reflects the growing acknowledgement of personal artistic identity during the Renaissance and embodies the ideal of the knowledgeable craftsman and artist.

description:

Die Steintorvorstadt war einst ein vor dem Steintor und der Stadtmauer gelegener Stadtteil.  (Museum Schloss Moritzburg Zeitz)

title: Portrait of a man (Alvise Contarini?)

title: Luthers Epitaph in Jena
description: The epitaph for Martin Luther should first only be provisionally housed in the St. Michael’s Church in Jena. However, there has never been a transport to Wittenberg. Philipp Melanchthon wrote the memorial text on the grave monument. The additions from 1571 are recorded on the copper engraving. Martin Bernigeroth, founder of a family of copper bars in Leipzig, created this in the time of baroque.  (Museum Schloss Moritzburg Zeitz)

description: The object features a Latin phrase ('Golden Mean') and a Greek phrase ('Horn of Amalthea'), referring to moderation and abundance respectively, symbolising the pursuit of a harmonious combination of the two opposites. description: Ο Άγιος Κοσμάς ο Αιτωλός καταγόταν από το χωριό Μέγα Δένδρο της Αιτωλοακαρνανίας, κι έζησε στα ασέληνα χρόνια της Τουρκοκρατίας. Σε ηλικία είκοσι ετών πήγε στο Άγιο Όρος, όπου σπούδασε σε σχολή και στη συνέχεια εκάρη μοναχός και χειροτονήθηκε ιερέας στη Μονή Φιλοθέου του Αγίου Όρους.  Τα θαύματα, που με τη δύναμη του Θεού επιτέλεσε εν ζωή και μετά το θάνατό του είναι αναρίθμητα.

title: Necklace (ogadéro)
description: The ogadéro (neck band or hangman’s rope), worn exclusively by Jewish women, was the main piece in the set of jewels received by Jewish brides in the Ottoman Empire. The necklace was given to the bride by her husband or father, usually together with a matching pair of bracelets. Elderly women kept the necklace as security in order to purchase a burial plot. Material and technique: Gold, stamped and hammered.

title: Decorative hatpin (roźeta - rose)
description: These pins underwent a number of metamorphoses. They began as turban pins worn by the Sultan's wives during the eighteenth century; at the end of the nineteenth century, in the transition from Ottoman to European dress, they ornamented the tokádo hats worn by married women in Izmir and Rhodes. When the tokádo ceased to be worn, they became lapel pins, and thus were preserved. Material and technique: Silver, gold, diamond chips, and ruby.

title: Hasidic Sabbath attire
description: The hassidim are a conspicuous example of voluntary segregation. As hassidism spread, numerous courts were set up around tzaddikim. title: Belt of inter-locking silver slides, with niello decoration, on a band of cloth, Cyprus, 18th century. Belt of interlocking silver and niello slides on a band of cotton woven in blue and white stripes. There are 13 slides with circular fronts and 13 shaped like a diabolo which fit between the circles. Each piece has a copper alloy bar at the back, so that they can be threaded on the belt. The fronts are decorated with cast stars, rosettes and tulips, picked out in niello. There is a loop soldered to the last slide at one end of the belt, and a sideways hook at the other, to fasten it, which may have been replaced.  Silver and niello, with copper alloy bars, on a belt of blue and white striped cotton.

title: Vitae episcoporum Cracoviensium
description: Manuscript of "Catalogus archiepiscoporum Gnesnensium" was written in 1531 on the order of Cracow Bishop and Deputy Chancellor of the Crown, Piotr Tomicki. It is a copy of the manuscript of Jan Długosz written in 1460-1472. It contains information about "The Archbishops of Gniezno and the Bishops of Cracow". The manuscript is richly illustrated. The illuminations were made by Stanisław Samostrzelnik, his co-wokers and imitators.

It is a collection of pictures of clothing worn by people from different countries and different walks of life, celebrating the diversity of national costumes. title: Psalter of Saint Louis - folio3v - Ark of Noah
description: This manuscript was produced in the mid thirteenth century for St. Louis. It has 78 full-page miniatures depicting scenes of the first books of the Old Testament. The scenes are all accompanied by an architectural framework inspired by Gothic buildings of the time. The Psalter of Saint Louis is one of the jewels of the history of France. Its colors (blue, red) are sublime, brilliant golds, gorgeous gothic frames. The selected thumbnail depicts Noah's ark.

title: 3D model of Ethiopian Octateuch
description: 3D model of the large format membranaceous manuscript of the 19th century (1437-1438). Written and illuminated by two Emiranians, Maka Maka Sêdêq and Pâwlos, who lived in Ethiopia around the mid 19th century. Ferdinando Martini acquired the monumental code, along with others, in Eritrea, where he was governor, from 1897 to 1907.

title: Psalms, Job, and Proverbs
description:
This tiny codex is one of 25 manuscripts ascribed to or signed by Isaac ben Obadiah. Each of its three biblical books opens with a full-page illustration: David and Goliath; Job with his three friends; and the Judgment of Solomon. The first page of Psalms contains the coat of arms of the Medici ruler of Florence, Lorenzo the Magnificent, a great Renaissance patron of the arts – evidence that during this time Hebrew manuscripts were commissioned by Christian humanists as 
well as by Jews.

title: Mūsā Nāma (The Book of Moses) by Mulana Shāhīn Shirazi
description: Mūsā Nāma is a poetic compilation of the biblical books of Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, and Deuteronomy, written in Judaeo-Persian in 1327 by Mulana Shāhīn Shirazi, the most prominent Jewish poet of medieval Persia. Melding Jewish, Muslim, and Persian legends, his text presents the main episodes in the life of Moses. Some of the nineteen miniatures in this rare copy reflect the influence of Muslim interpretation and visual tradition, such as the veiled depiction of Moses’ face, which recalls repr

title: The Rothschild Miscellany
description: The Rothschild Miscellany is a unique collection of 37 distinct texts: biblical and liturgical books; Rabbinic exegesis (midrash); texts on Jewish law, ethics, and philosophy; astronomy and historical legend; and even entertaining literature. With illumination on almost every leaf, this 946-page manuscript contains more than 200 detailed vignettes illustrating the text, dozens of gold and painted initial-word panels, and a variety of animal and floral ornamental depictions. title: Zeitz, Nicolaiplatz
description: Das Bankhaus Müller an der Nordseite des Nicolaiplatzes besitzt eine neobarocke Fassade. Ist im Kern aber tatsächlich ein barockes Gebäude, falls man der Datierung 1681 trauen kann.  (Museum Schloss Moritzburg Zeitz)

title: Zeitz, Brühl
description:
Ein Blick auf das schönste Haus am Brühl, das 1608 erbaute Haus Nr. 11.
Veit Ludwig von Seckendorff, einst Kanzler des Herzogs Moritz von Sachsen-Zeitz, gab als prominenter Bewohner dieses Stadtpalais dem frühbarocken Gebäude seinen Namen.
Anfang des 20. Jahrhunderts war es in Zeitz auch unter dem Namen Köttnitzsches Haus bekannt. Renaissance und Barock haben hier ihre Spuren hinterlassen. Heute noch nennt man das Gebäude Seckendorffsches Palais. Die Bezeichnung Köttnitzsches Haus konnte sich nu

title: Schloss Moritzburg Zeitz
description:
Schloss Moritzburg von Nordwesten aus gesehen. Teile der Befestigungsanlagen die Bischof Johannes II. von Schleinitz (1422-34) erneuern ließ, sind hier zu erkennen. Die Mauertürme wurden in der 2. Hälfte des 17. Jahrhunderts teilweise verändert. Der Wehrturm an der Nordwestecke besitzt auf dieser Aufnahme noch sein Dach.
Seit dem Jahr 2004 ist die Moritzburg wieder von einem Schlosspark umgeben. Die erste Landesgartenschau in Sachsen-Anhalt machte das möglich.  (Museum Schloss Moritzburg Zeitz)

title: Zeitz, Brühl Nr. 32
description:
In dem barocken Gebäude war zuletzt eine Holzwerkstatt untergebracht. Zwei Neidköpfe sollten das Haus beschützen, es waren regelrechte Zeitzer Berühmtheiten: Leckarsch und Blasarsch.
1953 wurde das baufällige Haus abgerissen. Die beiden Neidköpfe sind nun im Besitz des Zeitzer Museums.  (Museum Schloss Moritzburg Zeitz)

title: Zeitz, Nicolaiplatz
description: Das Haus Nicolaiplatz 3 liegt an der Ecke zur Rahnestraße. Gemeinsam mit den Häusern Nummer 1 und 2 nimmt es die gesamte Ostseite des Platzes ein. Die drei Gebäude gehörten ursprünglich zu einem Kaufmannshof. Das Haus mit Krüppelwalmdach erhielt sein äußeres Erscheinungsbild im 17. und 18. Jahrhundert, ist im Kern aber älter.  (Museum Schloss Moritzburg Zeitz)

title: Veit Ludwig von Seckendorf
description:
Dem Porträt des Gelehrten ist die allegorische Figur der Weisheit zugesellt. Diese besitzt die begnadete Fähigkeit, gleichzeitig Vergangenheit, Gegenwart und Zukunft im Blick zu haben.
Der berühmte Verfasser des "Fürstenstaates" war Kanzler in Diensten des Herzogs Moritz von Sachsen-Zeitz.  (Museum Schloss Moritzburg Zeitz)

title: Zeitz, Kalkstraße
description:
Blick auf das Haus Kalkstraße Nr.6.
Das an der Ecke zur Besenstraße gelegene Gebäude und das Nachbarhaus Kalkstraße Nr. 7 wurden im März 1980 abgerissen. Das Haus Nr. 7 war ein wertvolles barockes Bürgerhaus mit reichen Stuckdecken. Sie stammten vermutlich von Hans Michael Krippendorf, der auch die Stuckdecken im Zeitzer Rathaus schuf. Eine der Decken des Hauses Kalkstraße 7 hatte die allegorische Darstellung der Erdteile und der Jahreszeiten zum Thema.  (Museum Schloss Moritzburg Zeitz)

title: Courses in Upper Austria
description:
Interior footage of the Oberförsterei course in the “der der der der aufnahmen aufnahmen” Brühl 23 in Zeitz.
The city palace from the 17th century has lost its baroque shine today. In 1992 the Mitteldeutsche Zeitung reported optimistically about the repair of the house.
The building has a connection to the city wall. This vaulted passage is called “newsbed.” The name goes back to the name “Wackenbett.” The word wobble means stone. Steinstraße, Steintorturm and Steinsgraben can be found in the ne

title: Zeitz, Untermühle
description:
Die Untermühle in der Wasservorstadt wurde 1196 erstmals erwähnt. Die alte Probstei- oder Kaitulsmühle war die älteste der Zeitzer Mühlen. Im Jahr 1700 erfolgte ein Neubau.
Die Wasservorstadt lag früher außerhalb der Stadtmauer. Die Untermühle, wie auch ein Teil der anderen Häuser, unterstanden der Probstei, weshalb die Mühle auch lange Zeit "Probsteimühle" genannt wurde.  (Museum Schloss Moritzburg Zeitz)

title: Zeitz, Brühl
description:
Das Gasthaus "Zum Goldenen Palmbaum" war ein 1668 erbautes Barockgebäude. Als Residenzstadt erfuhr Zeitz eine wirtschaftliche Blüte. Zahlreiche Bürger wurden zu Bauherren, ließen sich moderne Gebäude errichten oder alte im neuen Stil modernisieren. Der Baugrund für den Gasthof "Zum Goldenen Palmbaum" wurde durch einen Brand vor dem Stephanstor verfügbar.
Hinter dieser Fassade vermutet man kaum einen malerischen Innenhof mit Fachwerkgebäuden und Laubengang.  (Museum Schloss Moritzburg Zeitz)

title: Zeitz, “Golden Corner” at the Roßmarkt
description: Aufnahme des Hauses 11 auf dem Roßmarkt Ecke Judenstraße. Das Wohnhaus besitzt ein auffallend hohes Krüppelwalmdach. Man erkennt nicht, dass es sich um ein Fachwerkhaus handelt. Die Andreaskreuze am Giebel sind heute wieder zu bewundern. Im Inneren des Hauses finden sich Spuren aus der Zeit des Barock und des Biedermeier.  (Museum Schloss Moritzburg Zeitz)

title: Zeitz, Zentralhalle
description:
Das barocke Stadtpalais in der Zeitzer Rahnestraße, datiert 1709, beherbergte im 20. Jahrhundert über viele Jahrzehnte ein Lichtspieltheater. Der Schriftzug "Zentralhalle" ist auf der Aufnahme aus den 30er Jahren zu erkennen. In den 70er und 80er Jahren warb die Einrichtung mit einer Kinobar.
Ein Herkules mit Keule überwacht seit jeher als Giebelbekrönung Ein- und Ausgang. In den letzen Jahrzehnten eine eher traurige Aufgabe, denn das Gebäude hat keine Nutzung mehr.  (Museum Schloss Moritzburg Z

title: Knight’s estate Großgestewitz
description:
Aufnahmen des von Joseph Christoph von Landwüst 1660 erbauten Herrenhauses in Großgestewitz.
Um das Jahr 1500 wurde das Gut und danach bis 1530 der gesamte Ort durch Hans von Landwüst übernommen. Besonders im Dreißigjährigen Krieges wurde der Ort in den Jahren 1637 und 1645 mehrfach verwüstet, so brannte auch das Schloss 1645 nieder. Es wurde bis zum Jahr 1660 wieder aufgebaut.
Die Familie von Landwüst besaß das Gut bis zum Aussterben ihrer Linie 1840.  (Museum Schloss Moritzburg Zeitz)

title: Schneidlingen
description: Wir blicken auf das Dorf Schneidlingen bei Staßfurt. Im Hintergrund fällt der mächtige quadratische Bergfried mit barocker Haube auf. Er gehört zu einer im Kern vermutlich mittelalterlichen Burganlage.  (Museum Schloss Moritzburg Zeitz)

title: Zeitz, Tiergarten
description:
Jagdgedenksteine im Zeitzer Tiergarten.
Bereits im 13. Jahrhundert wird das Aueholz nahe Zeitz erwähnt. Herzog Moritz von Sachsen-Zeitz ließ es mit einer Hecke umgeben und zu einem barocken Tiergarten umwandeln.
Die drei Steine erinnern an ein Jagderlebnis der Herzogin Maria Amalia von Sachsen-Zeitz. Am 20. Oktober 1710 soll sie hier mit einem Schuss drei Tiere erlegt haben.  (Museum Schloss Moritzburg Zeitz)

title: Zeitz, Schloßstraße
description: Eine Ansicht der Schloßstraße von Nordwesten. Wir blicken auf die Rückfront des Gerichtsgefängnisses, das um 1811 errichtet wurde. Dahinter befindet sich die barocke Orangerie. In den Hofdiarien findet sie 1703 erstmals Erwähnung. Ihr Südflügel ist hier bereits verschwunden. Einst erbaut um den frostempfindlichen Pflanzen aus dem Schlosspark im Winter Schutz zu bieten, hat sie im Lauf der Zeit ein wechselvolles Schicksal erfahren. title: Schloss Moritzburg Zeitz mit südwestlichen Wehrturm
description: The author of this view takes our view over the covered trench on the fortifications. These protected the former residence of the bishops of Naumburg-Zeitz even in the late Middle Ages. However, they could not prevent Swedish cannons from meaning the end of the old castle during the Thirty Years' War. Duke Moritz of Saxony-Zeitz had to initiate a new building for his main residence in 1657. Their western tower with lantern and weather vane are clearly shown here. For the creator of this leaf, th

title: Moritz from Saxony-Zeitz to Horses
description:
Reiterdarstellungen haben in der bildenden und angewandten Kunst eine lange Tradition. In der Zeit des Barock stand dieses Thema vorrangig im Dienste absolutistischen Machtdenkens und erfüllte zugleich die Funktion fürstlicher Repräsentation. Das Reiterstandbild wurde im Barock die beliebteste Darstellungsform des absolutistischen Herrschers.
Weit verbreitet waren im 17. und 18. Jahrhundert auch die mit der Hohen Schule aufgekommenen Reitbücher, deren Darstellungen der verschiedensten Gangarten

title: Silberdose des sächsischen Rats Nicolas Einert
description: Der kastenförmige Körper der vollständig vergoldeten Dose wird an seiner Unterseite von einem ausladenden profilierten Rahmen umschlossen, der auf vier flachen Kugelfüßen ruht. Der überstehende, mehrfach gestufte Deckel ist mit einem Scharnier befestigt. Er wird von der Figur eines Knaben bekrönt, der einen Schild mit der Aufschrift "gedencke meiner mein gott im besten" hält. Auf den vier Seiten der Dose verläuft eine gravierte Inschrift zum Gedenken an Nicolas Einerts 1692 in Pegau verstorbene

title: Herrenhaus des Ritterguts Rehmsdorf
description:
Freiherr Adam von Ende auf Trinum und Altjestnitz erwarb 1746 das Rittergut in Rehmsdorf. Sein Sohn, August Friedrich Freiherr von Ende, ließ 1750 das barocke Herrenhaus errichten. Die Familie konnte es 1756 beziehen. Unter den Endes erlebte das Gut seine Blütezeit. Die Gebäude hatten sich bis zum Ende des Zweiten Weltkrieges, trotz mehrmaligen Besitzerwechsels, nur geringfügig verändert.
Den sechseckigen Turm mit Wetterfahne und Patronatskreuz erhielt das Herrenhaus im Jahr 1846.  (Museum Schlo

title: Zeitz, Orangery
description:
Aufnahmen der zum Schloss Moritzburg Zeitz gehörigen barocken Orangerie.
In den Hofdiarien findet sie 1703 erstmals Erwähnung. Einst erbaut um den frostempfindlichen Pflanzen aus dem Schlosspark im Winter Schutz zu bieten, hat sie im Lauf der Zeit ein wechselvolles Schicksal erfahren. Unter anderem diente das Gebäude, nachdem die Stadt es 1821 erworben hatte, als Wohnstätte und Speiseanstalt für Arme. Die 1. Kleinkinderbewahranstalt der Stadt Zeitz war 1844 hier zu finden.

title: Schloss Heuckewalde
description:
Das Schloss wird in einer Urkunde von 1318 erstmals erwähnt.
Darin ging es um einen Vergleich, den Besitz Heuckewalde betreffend. Landgraf Friedrich der Gebissene (Friedrich I.) und Bischof Heinrich von Naumburg-Zeitz konnten sich einigen.
Die Anlage war ursprünglich ein Wehrbau. Der markante Turm, entstanden zwischen 1250 und 1370, kündet noch davon.
Nach 1364 nutzten die Bischöfe von Naumburg-Zeitz das Anwesen als Jagd- und Lustschloss.
Unter den Besitzern Bernhard von Pflugk und dessen Sohn G

title: Schloss Krossen
description:
Die Geschichte von Schloss Krossen reicht bis in das 10. Jahrhundert zurück. Die Anlage wurde zuerst 955 als castrum Crozsena urkundlich erwähnt. Ähnlich wie die benachbarte Haynsburg sollte sie wohl Schutz vor den Wenden bieten.
1585 verlieh Kurfürst August von Sachsen seinem langjährigen Hauptmann Wolf Ernst von Wolframsdorf für treue Dienste das Amt Crossen mit allen Rechten und Nutzungen auf Lebenszeit. Dieser ließ die Burg Crossen zu einer barocken Schlossanlage umbauen.

title: Zeitz, Nicolaiplatz
description:
Als herzogliche Residenzstadt erlebte Zeitz eine Blüte im Wohnhausbau. Viele Bauten entstanden neu oder wurden im Stil des Barock umgestaltet. Auch das Gebäude am Nicolaiplatz mit seinem hohen Giebel mit Ovalfenstern (bez. 1677) ist im Kern vermutlich älter.
Heute ist hier die Zweigstelle Zeitz der Musikschule des Burgenlandkreises, "Anna Magdalena Bach", untergebracht.  (Museum Schloss Moritzburg Zeitz)

title: Self-portrait
description: As well as demonstrating the painter's erudition, the use of Greek may also have served a symbolic purpose. In this painting, the artist is shown inscribing a skull with a Greek text that may read: "Behold: whither, sometime". The artist uses the language of timeless wisdom to write on an object symbolising the transience of human existence. This juxtaposition heightens the contrast between the eternal and the transient, which is the message of the painted scene.

department: The Lithuanian National Museum of Art
description:
Rausvo pusšilkinio brokato fone vario ir nesuktais šilkiniais siūlais įaustas raštas: tolygiai eilėmis išdėstytos stilizuotos perrištos gėlių puokštės. Lapai puokštėse lansuoti vario siūlais, brošuoti baltais, rausvais ir žalsvais šilkiniais siūlais. Veliumo centre prisiūtas kanoninis lygiašakis kryželis iš 1,5 cm pločio galionėlio, austo skersų juostelių raštu iš vario ir medvilninių siūlų. Pamušalas siūtas iš violetiniai dažytos medvilnės, šiuo metu išblukęs ir gausiai dėmėtas.

She wears a sleeveless chiton with a border at the upper edge, a himation with the fringe rendered by grooves´ and sandals. Sandal on right foot has profiled sides and is higher than the one on left foot. Front of sandals incised between first and second toe. Drilling

title: Edicula with the image of a god
Sculpture. Relief.
department: The Museum of Mediterranean and Near Eastern Antiquities
description: Male portrait head, possibly broken awavy from a relief. Rather weak face with high forehead. Symmetrical, sharply rendered eyebrows, Almond shaped eyes with upper and lower eyelids indicated. Small mouth with closed lips. Face framed by hair of short, schematically rendered curls, continuing down the cheeks. Beard of short, wavy strands. Slightly protruding ears. Back of head roughly hewn. Fine-grained, Italic marble.

Den 15 juni 1950 brann den gamla restaurangen ned. Den 18 november påbörjades uppförandet av den nya restaurangen, som invigdes den 17 juli 1952.

description: Vara de cuentas. El Diccionario de Autoridades define la vara como un instrumento formado de madera, u otra materia, que se usa para medir, graduado con varias señales, que notan la longitud de tres pies, y la dividen en tercias, quartas, sesmas, ochavas y dedos. Descrita como una pieza donde se graba en su corteza, ciertos signos inteligibles por todos los miembros del Concejo, como medio para llevar la contabilidad y se anotaba en ella mediante muescas.

title: Degollación de Santiago - Óleo/temple sobre lienzo
description: Degollación o martirio de Santiago. La escena se desarrolla sobre un fondo urbano clasicista, en segundo plano, el apóstol, de rodillas, con las manos cruzadas sobre el pecho y la cabeza tocada por un nimbo, está a punto de recibir el golpe de la espada del soldado que se sitúa a su espalda. En el primer plano el rey Heródes Agripa, con el cetro en su mano derecha, observa la escena junto a un grupo de soldados sentados en el suelo, algunos de ellos tocados con cascos portan fasces.

description: Scenă mitologică inspirată din Metamorfozele lui Ovidiu: transformarea nimfei Daphne în laur/dafin, pentru a scăpa de avansurile zeului Apolo. title: Brisé fan of paste board covered with silk, decorated with straw appliqué work, probably made in Florence, 1620s. Brisé fan of seven sticks, each one shaped to represent a curled feather. Cut straw, applied to silk covered cardboard. The sticks are made of rigid paste board, reinforced with fine metal rods or wires and covered in green silk decorated on both sides of high-quality appliquéd straw and cut roundels of gold paper. The sticks are kept together by a green silk ribbon.  The straw veneers have been cut into shapes of flowers and birds, whose plumage are cut frayed. The straw tail and crown of peacocks are cut to show blue and red silk on one side of the fan, which is most likely the front. A coat of arms is displayed on the central stick, of what probably is the front, made of gold paper, pale blue silk and cut straw.  Cut straw applied to silk covered cardboard, reinforced with metal rods, decorated with gold paper and silk.

description: Das Bild zeigt den leiblichen Tod des Buddhas, der ihn in das vollkommene Nirwana (Nehan-zu) führt. Shakyamuni liegt umringt von Trauernden aller Existenzstufen. Selbst die Natur reagiert mit welken Blättern und schäumenden Wellen auf seinen Tod. Das Bild aber soll dem Gläubigen eine hoffnungsfrohe Botschaft vermitteln, indem es die buddhistische Erlösung symbolisiert.

It was conceived as a familymausoleum and venue for preserving and displaying the owner’scollection of medieval art, but it can also be interpreted as theidealized vision of a medieval castle from the perspective of the19th century. This study clarifies to what extent our view of themedieval castle is contingent on the faults, fractures and“constructs” of modernity.

title: Byzantine church Episkopi in the village of Stavri in Mani
description: Η Επισκοπή βρίσκεται κοντά στο χωριό Σταυρί της δυτικής Μάνης και χρονολογείται στη μεσοβυζαντινή περίοδο. Vasul a fost publicat în cadrul monografiei arheologice, vezi bibliografia.

description: Ștefan Popescu a fost un pictor, desenator, gravor, membru de onoare al Academiei Române din anul 1936. A studiat la Academia de Arte din München și Academia de Arte din Paris. Este unul dintre gravorii de referință din arta românească, operele sale reprezentând un punct de reper în dezvoltarea graficii de șevalet cât și a gravurii din România. În Franța este cunoscut și cu numele de Stefan Popesco, din perioada în care a fost student la Academia de Arte din Paris.

title: O casă la țară
description: Imaginea unei case cu etaj, în planul doi, profilată pe un deal în fundal, în stânga. Pensulație liberă, vizibilă, în tonalități reci de griuri- albăstrui, cu accente calde și mari suprafețe albe. Lucrarea pune accentul pe atmosfera și pe construcția formelor. Semnat și datat stânga jos cu creion negru: „N. Dărăscu 1933”.

title: Fete lucrând la poartă
description: Nicolae Grigorescu, pictor de importanță națională, este fondatorul picturii moderne în România. Grigorescu a fost ucenicul lui Anton Chladek (miniaturist și portretist străin). Nicolae Grigorescu a fost supranumit „Nicu Zugravul” în perioada în care se ocupa cu pictura bisericilor. A studiat în Franța, la Paris și a fost membru al Școlii de la Barbizon.

title: Stânjenei
description: Peisaj citadin, având în prim plan stânjenei. în planul doi, în fundal, se vede partea de jos a unor clădiri și strada. Lucrat cu o pensulație liberă, într-o gamă cromatică cu alternanțe rece-cald: griuri luminoase de albastru în prim plan, violeturi, tonalități de verde cald și rece și accente de brunuri, ocruri, roz.

title: Țăran semănând
description: În prim plan, mergând spre stânga tabloului e înfățișat un țăran semănând. În jurul lui este peisajul unui câmp, cu dealuri în fundal, cu parcele de vegetație diferit colorate, ușor înclinate. Contraste de culori reci și calde, saturate: verzuri, ocruri, brunuri, violet - parcela arată ce ocupă spațiul din partea mediană a tabloutui - și accente de alb. Pensulație vizibilă. Semnat dreapta jos cu albastru: ”C. Ressu”.

title: Moschee din Maroc
description: Peisaj cu moschee care domină compoziția, câteva case și un pom în stânga. Lucrat în volume mari, monumentale, cu planuri bine marcate. Acorduri de ocruri, brunuri, accente roșcate verzuri închise și griuri colorate. Pensulație lată, vizibilă. Semnat stânga jos cu negru: „Șt. Popescu”.

title: Vâlcov
description: Peisaj cu biserica în ultimul plan, dominând compoziția. Reflexul ei se prelungește în apa aflată în prim plan. În stânga se află un podeț care duce spre biserică, creând și efectul de perspectivă. Acorduri predominant reci de verzuri, griuri albăstrui și accente de ocru și brun roșcat. Construcția formelor bine marcată, pensulație vizibilă. Semnat dreapta jos cu brun: ”Șt. Popescu, 29”.

title: Peisaj de iarnă
description: Peisaj cu case de țară în fundal, iar în prim plan câțiva pomi. Lucrat în tonalități de brun-negru în contrast cu alb-griul zăpezii. Efecte grafice ale crengilor copacilor, monumentalitate a formelor. Semnat dreapta jos cu negru: ”C. Ressu”.

title: Peisaj
description: Peisaj (probabil dobrogean), cu căsuțe printre dealuri. Orizontalele peisajului sunt contrabalansate de verticalele unui turn din stânga compoziției și a unui pom subțire din partea dreaptă. Cromatica caldă (verzuri, ocruri, galbenuri, accente de oranj, roșu) și pensulație nervoasă, ritmând lucrarea. Semnat dreapta jos cu verde: ”L. Grigorescu”.

title: Casă la Câmpina
description: Lucrarea înfățișează în prim plan o casă cu cerdac și cu scara ce urca spre prispă, ocupând partea superioară a compoziției. În planul secund, în dreapta se vede un gard și frunzișul pomilor. Gama cromatică caldă, luminoasă, de griuri, ocruri și accente de brun la acoperișul casei. Verdele din fundal susține prin contrast lucrarea. Pensulație largă, spontană, în special la frunziș și la cer. Semnat dreapta jos cu negru: ”Grigorescu”.

title: Ruinele Hârșovei
description: Peisaj înfățișând în prim plan, în umbră, colțul unei clădiri și o masă cu câteva personaje în costume turcești. În planul al doilea, apare o clădire în ruine, luminată de soare. O alternanță de planuri umbrite și luminate, de culori calde și reci dau senzația de spațiu. Pensulație liberă, vizibilă. Semnat și datat dreapta jos, cu ultramarin: ”Șt. Popescu '21”.

title: Stradă
description: Peisaj citadin, cu căsuțe vechi, la stânga o casă mai înaltă, creând o masă verticală în compoziție. Cateva personaje schițate în mișcare. Acorduri calde de ocruri, roșuri, oranj, accente de verde și brun

title: Zi (însorită) înnorată
department: Gavrilă Simion Eco-Museum Research Institute Tulcea
description: Lucrarea reprezintă un peisaj cu vegetație luxuriantă, construit din tușe vibrate de griuri colorate cu accente din tonuri de galben și brun. Median, uniformitatea ritmicității griurilor este ruptă de două structuri vegetale înalte colorate mai saturat. Există o semnătură cu datare în colțul dreapta jos „TBrădean1984”.

Domină o gamă rece de griuri albăstrui și verzuri, în contrast cu câteva accente calde de ocruri și roșuri. Contrastele închis-deschis pun în evidență planurile. Pensulație vizibilă, fragmentată. Semnat dreapta jos cu roșu „Dărăscu”.

În prim plan petele de culoare sunt mai întunecate, iar spre fundal se luminează. Forme și planuri bine definite, cromatica predominant caldă, ocruri, galbenuri, griuri colorate și accente de griuri reci, închise în prim plan. Semnat dreapta jos cu creion negru: ”Steriadi '924”.

title: Copii în fața casei
department: Gavrilă Simion Eco-Museum Research Institute Tulcea
description: Într-un dublu contrast de complementare: roșu-verde și albastru-oranj, pe verticală, se desfășoară un peisaj de iarnă, cu casă și copaci desfrunziți. În plan apropiat, la o distanță mică de casă, câteva pete de culoare conturează siluetele unor personaje. Acestea sunt redate asemenea unor umbre, peisajul surprins căpătând astfel un caracter universal. Gama cromatică este completată de negru și violet. description: Lucrarea reprezintă o scenă de muncă, unde un personaj este aplecat către sol. În stânga personajului, într-un plan mai apropiat, doi copaci înalți domină compoziția. În dreapta personajului, ansamblul plastic este echilibrat de un copac înalt în depărtare și un deal care trasează linia orizontului. Cromatica este dominată de nuanțe de verde și griuri colorate precum și accente de alb, galben, și brun; așezate cu o pensulație vibrată. Există o semnătură și o datare în colțul stânga jos „Tbrădean

description: Un peisaj simplu în care planul apropiat este separat de cel superior printr-o linie subțire, verde, de vegetație stilizată. Gama cromatică este altminteri redusă și formată din tonuri stinse de ocru, brun, albastru și violet. Culorile sunt așternute spontan, pe un suport uscat, zonele de interferență ale acuarelei lipsind. Lucrarea este semnată și datată, în partea stângă jos, cu negru: „Maria Constantin 979”.

title: Mal

description: Un peisaj cu vegetație bogată la baza unui mal de pământ este redat într-o cromatică echilibrată de tonuri reci și calde. Dincolo de malul pământiu din plan median, cerul albastru nu este deranjat de nicio interferență sau nor. În perspectiva străzii se dinsting pete de culoare ce sugerează o mulțime de oameni. title: Sct. Hans Evening at Vejle Fiord
description: The work is a landscape painting, but at the same time a portrait, propably depicting the artist’s wife Agnes Slott-Møller. The atmosphere in this painting is characterized by an unusual use of colour, not least in the woman’s prominent red cape.  Harald Slott-Møller had a background both in naturalism and symbolism, wherefore surface, colour and symbolic meaning intertwine in the painting.

description: Un peisaj panoramic luminos este construit pe orizontală într-o paletă cromatică bogată în nuanțe de albastru, verde, violet, oranj, galben, ocruri și brunuri. description: Un peisaj de seară se desfășoară pe orizontala lucrării, într-o cromatică echilibrată ce cuprinde nuanțe de albastru, verde, brun, ocruri, violet și accente de alb. Registrul apropiat este ocupat de o zonă cu vegetație și o casă în dreapta. Median, o barcă plutește pe o întindere de apă calmă. Registrul superior este format dintr-o zonă de vegetație de câmpie și cerul albastru-violet închis al înserării. title: Arhivele statului
department: Gavrilă Simion Eco-Museum Research Institute Tulcea
description: Din partea dreaptă a lucrării, într-o perspectivă laterală spre stânga, se desfășoară, de-a lungul unei străzi, un șir de clădiri. Desenul este simplu, cu linii domoale, continue, cu accente și detalii pe elementele arhitectonice. În stânga, în fundal, un copac redat minimalist prin puncte și linii, întregește peisajul arhitectonic. Lucrarea este semnată și datată, cu tuș negru, în partea dreaptă, jos: „Cik Damadian/ Podul Mihai Vodă/ 75”.

title: Sfârșit de octombrie
department: Gavrilă Simion Eco-Museum Research Institute Tulcea
description: Peisajul înfățișează o pădure realizată minimalist, desfășurată pe lungimea lucrării, în două registre principale. Cromatica este rece, în tonuri de gri și griuri colorate. Lucrarea este semnată și datată în partea stângă, jos, cu negru: „Balogh Lajos (1)974”.

title: Peisaj industrial (la Azuga)
department: Gavrilă Simion Eco-Museum Research Institute Tulcea
description: Lucrarea redă un peisaj industrial dintr-o zonă de munte. Construită pe verticală, imaginea surprinde în prim plan câteva clădiri redate cu brunuri, negru și nuanțe de verde. Dincolo de acestea, în perspectivă, se înalță munți și copaci falnici. Cromatica rece din registrul superior, compusă din nuanțe de violet și albastru, indică faptul că peisajul este surprins la ceas de seară. Lucrarea este semnată și datată, cu roșu, în dreapta jos: „c. Găvenea/ 1969”.

title: Peisaj dunărean
department: Gavrilă Simion Eco-Museum Research Institute Tulcea
description: Lucrarea este un peisaj cu o barcă acostată la un ponton. În dreapta se vede semi-profilul unei clădiri, iar în fundal, vegetație într-o cromatică echilibrată, cald-rece. Lucrarea este semnată în partea dreptă, jos, cu creion roșu: „C. Găvenea”. Lucrarea este nedatată.

title: Peisaj din Valea Mureșului
department: Gavrilă Simion Eco-Museum Research Institute Tulcea
description: Un peisaj de seară, cu vegetație bogată, se desfășoară pe orizontală. Gama cromatică cuprinde tonuri de brun, verde, albastru alături de accente de alb, galben, violet. Culorile interferează predominant în registrul inferior și în cel superior, creând un aspect marmorat, și fin al peisajului. Lucrarea este semnată și datată în partea dreaptă jos, pe lucrare: „Siklody T./ 1977”.

title: Înserare pe Lacul Calica
department: Gavrilă Simion Eco-Museum Research Institute Tulcea
description: Într-un echilibru cromatic desăvârșit este redat un peisaj mirific de baltă. În plan apropiat, vegetație bogată încadrează un petic de plajă. Dincolo de aceasta, central, într-o perspectivă liniară, se întinde apa lină a unui lac. Linia orizontului, joasă, este marcată de vegetație deasă ce se oglindește în luciul netulburat al apei. Cerul înserării ocupă mai bine de jumătate din verticala imaginii. Gama cromatică este compusă din verde, albastru, violet, ocruri, brunuri și galben. Culorile sunt

title: Iazurile la Calica
department: Gavrilă Simion Eco-Museum Research Institute Tulcea
description: Peisajul este realizat într-o cromatică rece formată din nuanțe de verde, albastru, violet, alături de brun, roșu, ocru și griuri colorate. O întindere de apă transparentă este fragmentată de o porțiune de vegetație, pe diagonală-dreapta. Pe fundalul cerului grizat se înalță stâlpi de electricitate solitari. Culorile sunt așternute spontan, cu repeziciune, pe un suport uscat, zonele de interferență lipsind. Lucrarea este semnată și datată, în partea dreaptă jos, cu negru: „Maria Constantin 979”.

title: Peisaj câmpenesc cu gârlă
department: Gavrilă Simion Eco-Museum Research Institute Tulcea
description: Lucrarea reprezintă un peisaj rustic dominat de vegetație deltaică. În registrul median, în partea dreaptă se află o cabană de stuf care străjuiește întinderea de apă. În registrul inferior șerpuiește un curs de apă. În fundal, se zăresc câțiva copaci înalți, îndesați în partea dreaptă. Culorile sunt așternute elegant, catifelate, predominând nuanțele de verde, ocru, albastru, brun și griurile colorate. Artista construiește în cărbune scheletul lucrării. Lucrarea este nesemnată și nedatată.

title: Dunărea la Tulcea
department: Gavrilă Simion Eco-Museum Research Institute Tulcea
description: Peisajul este realizat într-o cromatică predominant rece, compusă din nuanțe de albastru, verde și violet. Pe malul unei ape câteva figuri sunt surprinse alături de o barcă și un vaporaș, acostate la acesta. Dincolo de apa străvezie, pe malul opus, în ceață, se disting copaci și clădiri ce se contopesc sub cerul violet-cenușiu. title: Dimineața în deltă
department: Gavrilă Simion Eco-Museum Research Institute Tulcea
description: Într-o perpectivă liniară, dincolo de rotunjimile unor dealuri cu vegetație uscată, se zărește o întindere transparentă de apă pe care plutesc, zone de vegetație verde. În fundal, linia subțire a orizontului dă loc cerului de un albastru grizat, redat precum o oglindă a apei. Culori așternute spontan: brunuri, ocruri, verde și albastru, interferează catifelat într-o imagine de vedere pitorească a deltei. Lucrarea este semnată cu brun, în dreapta jos: „Botar”. Lucrarea este nedatată.

title: Peisaj
department: Gavrilă Simion Eco-Museum Research Institute Tulcea
description: Pete semitransparente și opace de culoare interferează pe toată suprafața imaginii. Cerul violet închis pare a „curge” delicat pe spațiul lăsat liber al hârtiei, subliniind atmosfera înserării. title: Întoarcerea de la pescuit
department: Gavrilă Simion Eco-Museum Research Institute Tulcea
description: O cromatică bazată în principal pe tonuri de albastru, verde și violet suprinde pe întinderea unui canal, o barcă ce se deplasează spre stânga, oblic. Cerul înserării este realizat prin pete spontane, vibrate, orizontale de acuarelă. Încadrat de vegetație bogată ce se contopește cu apa și cu cerul peisajul capătă un caracter fotografic pitoresc. title: Apus de soare pe Mureș
department: Gavrilă Simion Eco-Museum Research Institute Tulcea
description: Peisajul este realizat pe orizontala lucrării în valorații de brunuri, ocruri și griuri colorate. Cerul cețos din jumătatea superioară, reflectă peisajul întunecos din plan inferior. Zone de vegetație încadrează diagonala unei ape alburii, liniștite. Petele de culoare transparente sau opace, interferează pe hârtie creând aspectul unei imagini fluide, statice și dinamice în același timp. Lucrarea este semnată și datată, în partea stângă jos, cu negru: „Balogh Lajos 1974”.

title: Remorcher la mal
department: Gavrilă Simion Eco-Museum Research Institute Tulcea
description: Un peisaj de seară cu un vas acostat la mal în centrul de interes este realizat într-o cromatică ce cuprinde: ocru, brun, verde, roșu, albastru, oranj, violet și galben. title: Gerro dalhangari
department: Museum of Cultures of the World
description: During the Joseon dynasty, there were two stages of ceramic production marked by the Japanese invasion of Korea (1592-1598). Before the 17th century, Goryeo celadon evolved towards the production of buncheong olive green and grey glazed wares, with a considerable diversity of typologies and decorations with great graphic impact.

title: Ampolla
department: Museum of Cultures of the World
description: Korean bronzes usually seek simplicity of forms, without any decoration or with a few incrusted copper or silver naturalist motifs. In general, their characteristic features are simple outlines with long narrow necks, emulating celadon forms, to the extent that, given the similarities, some authors have suggested that celadon were used to drink alcohol from in the winter and the bronzes were used for the same purpose in summer.

title: Constituent, Confederate, and Conquered Space. The Emergence of the Mittani State
department: Open Access Publishing in European Networks Foundation
description: The Mittani empire is one of the most enigmatic political structures in Mesopotamian history. Reconstructing the emergence and the organisation of this state, whose territory encompassed Upper Mesopotamia touching the Levant and the piedmont plains of the Zagros in the East at the height of its power, is exceedingly difficult. Cuneiform specialists, archeologists and historians discuss the Mittani state with regard to modes of spatial organisation co- and preexisting in the region.

description:
Salomon de Ciaves, a Portuguese originned Dutch immigrant to Izmir, donated one of his large courtyard houses to the Jewish Community in 1724 to be used as a synagogue.  Ensuring the purchase of all the religious books and sacred objects required, he also donated some of the neighboring houses and shops in order to bring some revenue to the institution.

title: Etz Hayim Synagogue
description:
The Etz Hayim Synagogue, which has survived the dangers of fire and earthquake many times, was damaged in the fire of 1841 and had been repaired by Daniel de Sidi in 1851.
The Tevah (prayer reading platform) of this synagogue, which was built in a central plan, was moved from the center to the sides of the Ehal (cabinet where the Torah scrolls are stored), inspired by European synagogue architecture, in the early twentieth century.

title: Bet Hillel Synagogue
description:
Rabbi Hayim Palachi (1788-1869) and his son Rabbi Abraham Palachi (1809-1899) were recognized as the leading theologians of the Izmir Jewish Community in the 19th century. The reputation of both went beyond Izmir and the Ottoman Empire, causing the Jewish theologues of Europe and Middle East to come to Izmir.
Rabbi Hayim Palachi wrote a total of 72 books during his lifetime, and 26 of them were published. He was awarded the “Theologian in charge of justice” medal by the Sultan Abdulmecid in 1861

title: Flat Collar with Plain Linen Jabot and Needle Lace
description: Small scale Venetian needle lace was enormously popular for collars in the late 17th century. Characteristic are the scrolling floral patterns, amid which are incorporated all manner of details. The tiny vines and petals worked in relief almost seem to grow from the lace.

title: Kraag of col rabat van Venetiaans naaldkant met linnen halsstuk. Sluiting middenvoor.
description: Kraag of rabat van Venetiaans naaldkant met linnen halsstuk. Sluiting middenvoor. Het patroon heeft rijk vertakte, gevederde ranken met bloemknoppen en kleine bloemen in composiet, lelie- en granaatmotief. Hierdoor blijft weinig ruimte meer over voor vulling. De grond is opgebouwd uit stokjes met picots. De kraag is afgezet met een rand van fijne punten, voorzien van picots.

title: Dolk
description:
Inköpt av Gösta Benckert 1958.

Ceremoniell dolk för rituellt bruk inom den tibetanska buddismen. Symbolen, som påminner om en krona, heter vajra (sanskrit) eller dorje (tibetansk). Denna symbol korresponderar med andra symboler så som vapen, dolk i detta fall. Symbolen är maskulin och används tillsammans med feminina symboler, exempelvis skålar.

We also see the film-maker playing with his youngest daughter on a beach building sandcastles and posing for portraits on a rocky cliff top. Domestic scenes also show the family together as they leave a house.

title: Peleus raubt Thetis - Ödipus und die Sphinx
department: Archaeological Museum of the University of Münster
description:
Die Außenseite dieser Trinkschale ist mit zwei Bildfriesen verziert, die durch die Henkel getrennt sind.
Im Zentrum des ersten Bildes ist die Entführung der Meeresgöttin Thetis durch Peleus, den König der Myrmidonen dargestellt. Dieser hat die junge Frau mit festem Griff an der Hüfte umfasst, während sie verzweifelt, aus der Umklammerung zu entkommen und sich Hilfe suchend an ihre Gefährtinnen wendet, die erschrocken und aufgeregt gestikulierend die Flucht ergriffen haben.
Dem Mythos

title: Attisch schwarzfigurige Hydria
department: Archaeological Museum of the University of Münster
description:
Für das täglich benötigte Trinkwasser dient eine Hydria. Ihre Form ist so auseklügelt, dass sämtliche Elemnte den verschiedenen Gebrauchsweisen entsprechen.
Durch einen ausladenen Fuß erhält das Gefäß Standfestigkeit.
Damit das Wasser nicht sofort verdunstet ist die Gefäßschulter eingezogen. Eine breit ausladene Lippe erleichtert sowohl das Füllen als auch das Ausgießen.
Durch zwei horizontale Griffe ist das Gefäß leicht hochzuheben. Ein Griff in dem hochgezogenen Vertikalhenke
